content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2025 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-08-2025. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 08-08-2025. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Natural/Life Science with a Ph.D. in Genomics/Bioinformatics/Life Sciences, or an M.Sc/M.Tech in Bioinformatics with 4 years of experience in genomic sequencing data analysis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 per month, plus 24% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your bio-data and required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is located in New Delhi, Delhi.
